The standard-library exact-rational verifier independently enumerates likelihoods for 576 two-member and 1,330 three-member rational profiles and verifies the extremal family. Finite tests supplement, not replace, the analytic all-real proof.

value.rationale: A new 2026 study gives a natural governance mechanism where effort determines both information and vote weight. The fully motivated question is the accuracy price of this institutional weighting relative to the optimal statistical aggregator. The result locates all inefficient asymmetric profiles and gives a sharp dimensionless 6.25 percentage-point loss, a useful institutional benchmark beyond classic log-odds optimality.
